scope: Interface-design guidance adapted from the four requested GOV.UK Brand source sections. civica.uk identity applies to project documentation and promotion; household or business identity is optional and user chosen.

sources.title: Colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Separate palette tiers from functional use and check colour combinations.

sources.title: GOV.UK is a blue brand
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Consistency and contrast inform civica; official blue/teal identity and brand-team approval route do not apply.

sources.title: Web colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Role-based functional colours, quiet borders and strong input boundaries.

sources.title: App colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Coherent key-screen hierarchy and mode-specific palette adaptation.

sources.title: Social colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Tone depends on context; accessible combinations and non-colour cues remain necessary.

sources.title: Print colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Print is a separate output medium; do not replace supplied screen values with print references.

sources.title: Chart colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Categorical and quantitative scales differ; readability and labels take priority over expression.

sources.title: Map colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Keep spatial marks legible and supplement colour with labels and shapes.

sources.title: Illustration colour
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Restrained colours, contextual palette and recognisable key elements.

sources.title: Typography
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Typeface identity is official; readable hierarchy transfers.

sources.title: Web typography
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: The official font requirement is tied to the official service context.

sources.title: App typography
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Respect native platform conventions when custom fonts cannot or should not apply.

sources.title: Social typography
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Readable weight, scale, spacing, alignment and sans-serif fallbacks.

sources.title: Print typography
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: 12pt body and 16pt heading reference; crown/logo print geometry excluded.

sources.title: Design System typeface
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Use an alternative typeface outside the relevant official service domain.

sources.title: Data principles
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Purpose, audience, accuracy, accessibility and chart selection.

sources.title: Charts
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Titles, measures, periods, annotations, sources and justified interactivity.

sources.title: Dashboards
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Frequently refreshed overview with hierarchy and maintenance obligations; existing HA renderer retained.

sources.title: Maps
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Spatial context, appropriate extent, scale, attribution and text alternatives.

sources.title: Data examples
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Indicative publishing graphics are not an operational chart specification.

sources.title: Illustration
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Illustrations explain a story; functional icons have a separate purpose.

sources.title: Illustration principles
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Simple flat forms, limited detail, hierarchy and purposeful storytelling.

sources.title: Creating illustrations
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Research, sketch, simplify, compose and review; do not adopt official dot construction.

sources.title: Layout of a scene
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Use layering, empty space and framing without obstructing the main action.

sources.title: Characters
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Respectful representation and believable proportion; official character construction is not a requirement.

sources.title: Hands and gestures
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Show a gesture clearly only when needed; retain accuracy for instructional actions.

sources.title: Objects and props
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Use real reference and recognisable simplified objects.

sources.title: Incorrect visual approaches
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Avoid irrelevant decorative imagery, clutter, gradients and stereotypes; functional chart/icon exceptions documented.

sources.title: Illustration examples
sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval
sources.focus: Channel examples inform composition, not permission to reproduce official imagery.

sources.evidence_method: Official published page read through web retrieval

retained_user_requirements: civica.uk identifies the project, documentation and promotion. In-home identity is optional and belongs to the household or business; official GOV.UK identity remains excluded.
Ten exact supplied palettes; Vivid/Muted independent of Light/Dark.
Stable generated chart identity colours; 1.5px operational Energy lines.
Preserve native Home Assistant data, controls and supported operational semantics.

out_of_scope.reason: Official dot/device construction is not adopted; supplied civica identity remains authoritative.
Existing local supplied-asset and provenance rules continue; no official mark or geometry is imported.
Official channel identity layouts do not become local requirements.

rules.title: Keep the selected palette and identity roles separate
acceptance_checks: Every selected primary/canvas matches palettes.json.
Text-only household identity remains a complete option; no project mark is required.
Optional supplied artwork keeps its proportions and colours, with readable text identification.
rules.scope: Theme selection, optional household personalisation and separate project identity
rules.requirement: Use the exact selected palette without inserting a required project logo. Keep any chosen household or business artwork unchanged. Use supplied civica.uk artwork only for project documentation or promotion; exclude official GOV.UK identity.

rules.title: Choose a colour by its job
acceptance_checks: Changing brand leaves warning/error/success meaning intact.
Text and fill use documented semantic pairs, including dark mode.
rules.scope: Interface colour tokens and semantic states
rules.requirement: Assign colours by identity, reading, interaction, state or data role; keep those roles independent.

rules.title: Test combinations and retain another cue
acceptance_checks: Audit actual rendered pairs and non-colour alternatives.
Verify keyboard focus independently of brand swatches.
rules.scope: Rendered text, controls and meaningful graphical objects
rules.requirement: Meet applicable contrast requirements on actual surfaces and communicate essential meaning without colour alone.

rules.title: Separate dividers from editable boundaries
acceptance_checks: Card divider and input boundary remain visibly different.
No global radius reset or border override damages native controls.
rules.scope: Structural borders, inputs and native control geometry
rules.requirement: Separate quiet structure from recognisable controls and strong input/focus boundaries without global radius resets.

rules.title: Preserve device, warning and notification meaning
acceptance_checks: Native entity states remain recognisable after a palette change.
Unread counts, severity and service identity are not conflated.
rules.scope: Device state, manufacturer identifiers and attention counts
rules.requirement: Preserve meaningful native device state and separate unread attention counts from severity and service identity.

rules.title: Review every display context
acceptance_checks: Exercise ten palettes × two tones × two modes on affected surfaces.
Inspect forced colours, focus and native editor density without clipping.
rules.scope: Affected components in all supported tone/mode and accessibility contexts
rules.requirement: Keep Vivid/Muted independent of Light/Dark and verify actual surfaces, focus and forced-colour behaviour.

rules.title: Keep chart and map scales independent
acceptance_checks: Existing chart identities remain stable when brand/order/visibility changes.
Any proposed quantitative scale declares meaning and missing-data treatment.
rules.scope: Categorical chart identities and proposed quantitative map/chart scales
rules.requirement: Keep operational chart identities independent of the brand palette and document quantitative scale meaning.

rules.title: Adapt the output channel without importing identity
acceptance_checks: Export/media treatment is identified as separate from the live UI.
Screen palette values and supplied metadata are preserved.
rules.scope: Screen, promotional and print colour output
rules.requirement: Preserve the authoritative screen palette and supplied metadata; assess exported media separately.

rules.title: Use the approved typeface, not the official identity font
acceptance_checks: Computed maintained UI font stack contains no GDS Transport.
Wordmark artwork remains separate from editable text.
rules.scope: Maintained civica interface and documentation typography
rules.requirement: Use the approved Arial/Helvetica/sans-serif stack and keep official GDS Transport out of active use.

rules.title: Build hierarchy with meaning, size and weight
acceptance_checks: Heading outline remains meaningful without CSS.
Long names/instructions wrap without shrinking or artificial headline limits.
rules.scope: Headings, labels and explanatory text
rules.requirement: Make heading semantics and readable visual hierarchy agree; allow essential labels to wrap.

rules.title: Keep values, units and dates understandable
acceptance_checks: Signed values and units survive narrow widths and text scaling.
Locale/timezone context is preserved for operational data.
rules.scope: Operational readings and exported measurement text
rules.requirement: Retain essential signs, units, dates, source identity and locale/timezone context in readable text.

rules.title: Respect native density and operating-system controls
acceptance_checks: Check native editors/tables/dialogs as well as custom cards.
OS-owned UI and code alignment are preserved.
rules.scope: Custom UI, native dense surfaces, charts and OS-owned controls
rules.requirement: Apply the documented local/native type scales while preserving native scaling, editor alignment and OS-owned UI.

rules.title: Verify text scaling and failure states
acceptance_checks: Inspect 200% text size and narrow reflow on affected component.
Full essential labels remain available without pointer hover.
rules.scope: Affected text and controls at narrow widths and user text settings
rules.requirement: Preserve essential labels and context under zoom/text scaling without requiring pointer hover.

rules.title: Separate document and promotional typography
acceptance_checks: Exported document is checked at its actual size and has readable text.
Graphic-only copy has an equivalent accessible text version.
rules.scope: Printable household documents and promotional text
rules.requirement: Use readable channel-specific starting sizes, enlarge for reader needs and provide accessible accompanying text.

rules.title: Start with a household question
acceptance_checks: Title and surrounding explanation state the actual task.
Unknown or no-data periods do not acquire fabricated conclusions.
rules.scope: Dashboard and publication data presentation
rules.requirement: State the household question and avoid a conclusion unsupported by available observations.

rules.title: Choose a chart type for the data relationship
acceptance_checks: Chart family reflects the actual variable and comparison.
Unsupported chart families are not claimed as adapted.
rules.scope: Chart type choice and maintained Energy chart scope
rules.requirement: Choose a truthful representation for the data relationship and preserve the maintained chart-family contract.

rules.title: Give each chart enough context
acceptance_checks: A person can identify measure, period and source without guessing from colour.
Exported context remains complete outside the dashboard.
rules.scope: Operational charts, static charts and exported data
rules.requirement: Supply sufficient title, measure, period, source and qualification context for the actual output.

rules.title: Protect the underlying observations
acceptance_checks: Compare source values/IDs with rendered and tabular values before/after lifecycle changes.
Inspect missing, zero, negative and non-zero-axis cases.
rules.scope: Native chart adaptation, data alternatives and lifecycle restoration
rules.requirement: Preserve observed values, identities, original dates, missingness and current period without fabricated readings.

rules.title: Use the operational chart specification
acceptance_checks: Canvas geometry, legend keys and tooltip markers match the shared spec.
Theme, series-order and visibility changes preserve identity and line weight.
rules.scope: Supported operational Energy plots, legends and tooltip markers
rules.requirement: Use the shared identity colours, matching cues and 1.5px line weight across normal and interaction states.

rules.title: Retain useful native interaction
acceptance_checks: Native legend/date/keyboard interactions still work.
No new renderer or service call is introduced merely for branding.
rules.scope: Maintained native Energy adapter and existing chart interaction
rules.requirement: Retain useful native controls and accessibility through bounded public ECharts APIs and a version-verified private HA adapter.

rules.title: Provide a usable alternative and honest scope
acceptance_checks: Alternative contains the same supported facts with clear scope.
Keyboard users can reach, open and page the table.
rules.scope: Supported Energy data tables and proposed chart alternatives
rules.requirement: Provide a usable equivalent with honest selected-period scope and test it separately from the visual chart.

rules.title: Treat maps as operational evidence
acceptance_checks: Map legend, attribution, scale/extent and alternative remain meaningful.
A schematic is never presented as a surveyed position or live map.
rules.scope: Native map content and future spatial adapters
rules.requirement: Preserve spatial meaning, source context and text alternatives; distinguish schematics from actual locations.

rules.title: Separate publishing graphics from live monitoring
acceptance_checks: Publishing example declares source/synthetic status and denominator.
Operational and promotional treatment are explicitly separated.
rules.scope: Publishing summaries versus operational monitoring
rules.requirement: Keep fixed editorial graphics clearly sourced and separate from live monitoring semantics.

rules.title: Use an illustration only when it explains something
acceptance_checks: The artwork communicates a named task-relevant fact.
Text remains sufficient when the illustration is unavailable.
rules.scope: New explanatory illustrations and dashboard imagery
rules.requirement: Use an illustration for a task-relevant message, with the instruction available in text.

rules.title: Draw original, simple civica artwork
acceptance_checks: Illustration provenance and original source are recorded.
Small-size review confirms a clear focal point without official identity assets.
rules.scope: New civica explanatory artwork
rules.requirement: Create simple original artwork without copying official identity assets or altering supplied civica marks.

rules.title: Use a restrained palette without borrowing status
acceptance_checks: Colour supports the message and does not imply an unverified state.
Illustration restrictions are not applied to functional icons/charts.
rules.scope: Explanatory illustration family, excluding functional icons and data marks
rules.requirement: Use restrained purposeful colour without decorative gradients/effects or false state meaning; retain functional cues elsewhere.

rules.title: Compose around the action
acceptance_checks: Action and sequence remain clear at narrow/wide sizes.
Any essential animation has a static accessible route.
rules.scope: Composition and sequencing of explanatory illustrations
rules.requirement: Make the action clear through hierarchy, whitespace and coherent sequence across screen sizes.

rules.title: Represent people and gestures carefully
acceptance_checks: Representation is relevant and avoids stereotypes.
Specific gestures and instructions have appropriate subject review.
rules.scope: Illustrated people, gestures and avatars
rules.requirement: Represent people respectfully and validate specific instructional gestures without inferring identity or capability.

rules.title: Give the image the right alternative
acceptance_checks: Informative meaning is available without seeing the image.
Redundant/decorative visuals do not create repeated announcements.
rules.scope: Informative, redundant and decorative image alternatives
rules.requirement: Expose essential image meaning accessibly and suppress redundant announcements without omitting required alternative attributes.

rules.title: Keep icons functional and recognisable
acceptance_checks: Known entities retain their icon meaning and accessible names.
Functional symbols remain legible in light/dark and forced colours.
rules.scope: Functional entity/domain and navigation icons
rules.requirement: Retain recognisable native meanings, accessible names and component-specific vector/focus treatments.

rules.title: Preserve photographs, video and map evidence
acceptance_checks: Operational content retains identifying detail and source context.
Illustrative and live/recorded media cannot be confused.
rules.scope: Photos, media, cameras, map tiles and illustrative stand-ins
rules.requirement: Preserve operational evidence and distinguish diagrams, still images and live states.

rules.title: Limit personal information in shared imagery
acceptance_checks: Public examples contain invented or appropriately cleared content.
Presentation changes preserve native privacy/access controls.
rules.scope: Public examples and personal household imagery
rules.requirement: Use invented or appropriately cleared personal content and preserve native privacy/access controls.

rules.title: Deliver and review the complete asset
acceptance_checks: Source/rights/alternative/background metadata are present.
Rendered review is recorded separately from syntax and source review.
rules.scope: New asset delivery, rights metadata and rendered review
rules.requirement: Record source, rights, purpose, alternatives and display context, then verify rendered results separately from syntax.

rights_note: Guidance is paraphrased with source links. No official brand illustrations, fonts, logos or graphic-device artwork are copied into these examples; schematic SVGs are original project markup.

normative_levels.MUST: Required local acceptance condition within the stated scope.
normative_levels.SHOULD: Recommended starting point; record a reason for a different approach.
normative_levels.MAY: Permitted option, not an adoption requirement.

display_name: Design styles: colour, typography, data and illustration

scope_revision.authority: Explicit user clarification in this task
scope_revision.decision: Remove the Brand guidance navigation group; present colour/data/type/illustration as design styles. Do not require civica.uk identity inside a home. Add optional family-name, crest and business-logo guidance. This is a design-system update only.
scope_revision.legacy_identifiers: BG rule IDs and brand-guidance JSON routes remain stable for existing references.
